sections.title: General Aptitude
sections.description: Quantitative problems—arithmetic, percentages, time & work, and data interpretation.

questions.text: If 20% of a number is 48, what is the number?
questions.explanation: Let the number be x. 0.2x = 48, so x = 48 / 0.2 = 240.

questions.text: A shopkeeper buys an article for ₹400 and sells it at a profit of 25%. What is the selling price?
The price of an item is reduced by 10% and then increased by 10%. Compared to the original price, the net change is:
questions.explanation: After −10% then +10% on the reduced price, net factor is 0.9 × 1.1 = 0.99, i.e. 1% decrease.

questions.text: If the cost price is ₹800 and loss is 12.5%, what is the selling price?
The ratio of two numbers is 3 : 5. If their sum is 64, what is the larger number?
questions.explanation: Parts are 3k and 5k. 8k = 64 → k = 8. Larger number = 5 × 8 = 40.

questions.text: Milk and water are mixed in the ratio 4 : 1. How much water must be added to 20 L of this mixture to make the ratio 4 : 3?
questions.explanation: In 20 L, milk = 16 L and water = 4 L. For ratio 4:3 with 16 L milk, water needed = 12 L. Extra water = 12 − 4 = 8 L.

questions.passage: Remote work has shifted how teams collaborate. Many companies now rely on async updates and documented decisions instead of long in-person meetings. Critics argue this can slow spontaneous problem-solving, while supporters note that written records reduce miscommunication and help new members catch up faster.
questions.text: According to the passage, what is one advantage supporters see in documented decisions?
options: They eliminate the need for any meetings
They help new team members understand context more quickly
They replace the need for managers
questions.explanation: The passage states written records help new members catch up faster.

questions.text: Choose the word closest in meaning to BRIEF.
questions.explanation: Brief means short in duration or length.
Abundant means plentiful; scarce is the opposite.

questions.text: Choose the word closest in meaning to DILIGENT.
questions.explanation: Diligent means showing care and effort in work.
Transparent means see-through or clear; opaque is the opposite.
